verdict.rationale: Fivetran's evidence shows AI applied to operational/pipeline concerns — an AI Support Assistant for troubleshooting sync issues (fivetran-docs-44, fivetran-docs-66) and an MCP server for querying connector/sync status (fivetran-docs-28, fivetran-docs-59) — plus a vague claim about creating a 'unified context layer' for other AI tools (fivetran-docs-7). None of this shows Fivetran itself generating insights or suggestions from the actual business data content inside the product; it remains a data movement/ETL tool, not an analytics/insights engine.
